guard/30349.htm.text: Sentry Jenna: I am Sentry Jenna. I am on duty now so I cannot talk long. If you go into this cave, you will come to the Dark Elf Village. The grand building you see in front of you is the Shilen Temple.

links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

Q00168_DeliverSupplies/30349-02.htm.text: Sentry Jenna: Have you ever met Tetrarch Kaitar? They say that he has been blessed by the goddess with the power to predict future perils. Q00168_DeliverSupplies/30349-00.htm.text: Sentry Jenna: I am quite busy with the delivery of military goods, but I have no thought of seeking the help of a foreign race such as yourself. Go away. You're bothering my work. (Quest for Dark Elven characters.)

Q00168_DeliverSupplies/30349-04.html.text: Sentry Jenna: Haven't you been able to meet Master Harant yet? He is in the Sanctum of Shilen in the village. Well, we must first deliver these weapons to my sisters. Give me one sword, to begin with. And deliver the rest to Sentry Roselyn and Sentry Kristin . Please deliver the weapons to Sentries Roselyn and Kristin and bring back the Old Bronze Swords they have been using. Roselyn is standing guard at the entrance of the village. They will be used to make useful items, such as armor or shields. Our motto is to reward even the most minuscule of tasks. Please accept this as payment for your work on behalf of my sisters and me.
